headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Rust and Telemetry
summary: Integrate Rust for performance improvements, add telemetry features to monitor usage patterns, and incorporate command expansion checks to ensure safe installations.
actions: Implement core functionalities in Rust to leverage its safety and speed benefits, improving the overall performance of ClearInstall.
Add a telemetry feature to collect anonymous usage data, which can help identify common issues and optimize the application's risk assessment algorithms.
